description: This Java interface defines the API for managing MedicationDispense objects in the OpenMRS healthcare platform, including operations such as retrieval, saving, voiding, unvoiding, and deletion of MedicationDispense entities.

classes.name: MedicationDispenseService
classes.description: An interface providing methods to interact with MedicationDispense objects, including CRUD and status update operations.

methods.name: getMedicationDispense
methods.description: Retrieves a MedicationDispense by its ID.

methods.name: getMedicationDispenseByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a MedicationDispense by its UUID.

methods.name: getMedicationDispenseByCriteria
methods.description: Returns a list of MedicationDispense objects matching specified criteria.

methods.name: saveMedicationDispense
methods.description: Saves or updates a MedicationDispense object.

methods.name: voidMedicationDispense
methods.description: Voids a MedicationDispense, marking it as no longer active, with a reason.

methods.name: unvoidMedicationDispense
methods.description: Reverses the voiding of a previously voided MedicationDispense.

methods.name: purgeMedicationDispense
methods.description: Physically deletes a MedicationDispense from the database; should be used cautiously.
